issues.quote: Suddenly the green yard appears to me; it has already swallowed my room.
long shaggy wool leaps with them
Savage fury tears at itself, unable to break loose entirely from a deep muzzle, and only tosses up a heap of wool.
why does fear and hatred melt together in their fire?
At most you could tear a piece of my body
It is because of it that your front paws must grasp at air, that it chokes your throat and drives your fiery rage back into you.
What a stupid mutt. She shut her eyes
Well, and what about me? How? Did she forget me?

strengths.quote: It taps its little hammer against a great crystal bell (cuckoo! cuckoo!) and sows silence through the grass.
Ah, how much there is of everything: of sky, of sun, of cheerful green.
Red eyes leap, a broad forehead leaps, and white furry legs.
strengths.why: fragmented rhythm mimics the lunging dog

strengths.quote: Ah, what a trifle! What a trifle, if only you knew…
strengths.why: hints at the narrator's hidden weariness

strengths.quote: the tufts of wool knocked loose from her backside fly after her
